versions.title: PvP Duels
versions.notes: New Minigames menu with Zombie Apocalypse and PvP Duels: 1v1 other players online in an arena (random matchmaking or a secret code to fight a friend), same gear, best of 3 rounds.

versions.title: Speed Update
versions.notes: Runs faster: automatic resolution scaling when the game slows down, zombies in the fog are not animated or drawn, small zombie details only drawn up close, far-away animals skipped, fewer particles on Fast graphics.

versions.title: Scarier City
versions.notes: 3 new zombies: Hounds (zombie dogs in packs), Spitters (acid that burns) and Screamers (call every zombie nearby). The ruined city has blood, HELP written on walls, boarded windows, burning cars, sirens and howls. Zombie mode runs faster: it only loads and draws what the fog lets you see.

versions.title: Flash Fix
versions.notes: Fixed the whole screen flashing dark red all the time (the Lurker choke effect was showing even when nothing was choking you).

versions.title: The Lurker
versions.notes: New zombie: the Lurker hides in trees and on roofs, leaps down and chokes you with its tongue - click fast to break free before your air runs out. Scarier zombie looks (claws, bones, bloody faces, glowing eyes) and even darker between waves.

versions.title: Lights Out
versions.notes: Zombie mode is much darker - without your flashlight (L) you can barely see. The flashlight beam is a little stronger so you can rely on it.

versions.title: Grabbed!
versions.notes: Zombie mode is darker. Crawlers now grab your leg and hold you - click fast (or press jump) to kick free before they chew you up.

versions.title: Dying Batteries
versions.notes: The zombie-mode flashlight is dimmer and shorter, and now and then it flickers like the batteries are dying.

versions.title: Haunted Forest
versions.notes: The zombie forest is now a haunted forest: very tall dark pines, twisted oaks, dead trees with cobwebs, pale ghost trees, gravestones, fallen logs, glowing pumpkins and thicker fog.

versions.title: Campsites
versions.notes: Zombie forest is more open with glades; abandoned campsites with tents, fire pits and chests on the forest, plains and desert maps; crates and chests now hold many more kinds of loot (iron, gold, diamonds, tools, armor, food...).

versions.title: Zombie Apocalypse
versions.notes: Zombie Apocalypse mode: 4 maps (forest, desert, plains, ruined city), survival or waves, up to 5 friends, 6 kinds of zombies, crossbows, flame arrows, bolts, firecrackers, ammo crates, weapon repair, flashlight. Dropped items now show for friends.

versions.title: Controller Update
versions.notes: Play with an Xbox or PlayStation controller: Minecraft-style buttons, a cursor for menus and the inventory, and rumble.

versions.title: Phone Update
versions.notes: Plays on iPhone and Android: phone-sized controls and inventory, faster graphics on phones, chat and view buttons, add to home screen.

versions.title: The End Update
versions.notes: The End and the Ender Dragon boss fight, blazes, eyes of ender and end portals. All mobs look much better: 3D shading, shadows, more detail and death animations.

versions.title: Mobs & Blocks Update
versions.notes: Mobs hold real 3D items. Iron golems, squid, bats, rabbits, husks and strays. Clay, mushrooms, melons, cobwebs, hay, granite, diorite, andesite, lapis and more.

versions.title: Nether Update
versions.notes: The Nether with portals, lava and obsidian. New mobs: slimes, endermen, tameable wolves, zombified piglins, ghasts and magma cubes. Ender pearls.

versions.title: Blocks & Items Update
versions.notes: 14 new blocks (ladders, pumpkins, bookshelves, sugar cane, metal blocks...), gold, dyes, golden apples, and F5 third-person view.

versions.title: Accounts Update
versions.notes: Sign up on the big server with a name and password. Your name is yours forever and works from any computer.

versions.title: Rare Diamonds Update
versions.notes: Diamonds are about 5 times rarer, only deep down, and slower to mine. Villages give fewer diamonds.

versions.title: Big Server Update
versions.notes: Join the big always-online server with up to 100 players, or a friend's world with a code.

versions.title: Multiplayer Update
versions.notes: Play with friends over the internet using a join code. Chat, shared building, chests and mobs.

versions.title: Items & Beds Update
versions.notes: Detailed weapon and armor art, 3D held and dropped items, 2-block beds, launcher updates and old versions.

versions.title: Villages Update
versions.notes: Furnaces, villages and villager trading, 8 biomes, farming, touch controls for Chromebooks.

versions.title: Home Update
versions.notes: Chests, beds and sleeping, armor, and save slots that are saved as world files.

versions.title: Water & Mobs Update
versions.notes: Flowing water and buckets, skeletons, creepers and spiders, hunger and sprinting.

versions.title: First Release
versions.notes: Infinite terrain, caves, mining and crafting, day and night, zombies and animals. One world, kept in the browser.
